description: Positive fixture for #1639/#1695: correctness-review's Detect category 7 (error-signalling divergence). In a 106-line layered config module, load_config's docstring documents a Raises: contract (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError) that its body contradicts by catching both and returning {}; resolve_settings documents the same FileNotFoundError and so silently runs without a base config. load_optional_overrides, which catches FileNotFoundError and returns {} as its docstring says, is correct.

hard.note: The divergent loader sits beside load_optional_overrides, which uses the same try/open/return-{} shape correctly because its docstring documents the {} fallback; only comparing each docstring with its except clause separates the defect from its correct twin

_calibration.note: A 2026-08-01 live dispatch on the earlier 17-line version reported 1 error at high confidence on load_config. The module now adds a correct look-alike loader and three helpers; the window keeps room for the same finding reported once on load_config and once on resolve_settings. Re-measure on the current content.
